svg.title: Welcome to the wedding of Anand and Susmita
svg.desc: 24 by 36 inch portrait wedding welcome sign. Ivory paper, a delicate lotus and kolam header with sage leaves, a dark green woven lower border, rose pink lower floral corners, Lord Ganesha, a subtle pink lotus mandala behind enlarged title-case names, kolam accents, outlined Cormorant Garamond lettering, a compact date and venue layout, and an ivory celebration section with QR on the left and text on the right. Sunday, 29 November 2026, 12:28 PM. Shri Shakambari Mangal Karyalaya, Sulebhavi, Belagavi. Includes a QR code for https://anandwedsusmita.in/invitation. All visible artwork and lettering are vector shapes.
